insights.name: Observed installation return days — no person retention

insights.name: Local backup & durable restore outcomes
insights.description: Success = local file generated or durable merge completed. File sharing does not prove external storage or cloud backup exists. Controlled failure codes only; no file names, paths, content, counts or raw errors. Importer cancellation recorded separately.
insights.query: SELECT properties.operation AS operation, properties.provider AS provider, properties.result AS result, properties.failure_code AS failure_code, uniq(properties.analytics_record_id) AS completed_flows FROM events WHERE event = 'backup_restore_result' AND properties.release_channel = 'production' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND properties.platform = 'ios' AND properties.analytics_record_id IS NOT NULL AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY operation, provider, result, failure_code
insights.verification: Saved query executed successfully in whole-dashboard refresh; production empty

insights.name: Latest account / backup / capability state
insights.description: Latest snapshot per consenting installation in collection period. Baseline no_account/local_only automatic; device backup existence unknown. Unsupported account/sync/widgets/onboarding/purchase reported false, never measured as zero adoption. State is observed, not server truth.
insights.query: SELECT account_state, primary, primary_source, secondary, backup_status, widgets_available, purchase_available, onboarding_available, onboarding_state, widget_privacy, widget_privacy_source, count() AS installations FROM (SELECT distinct_id, argMax(properties.account_state, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS account_state, argMax(properties.backup_primary, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS primary, argMax(properties.primary_source, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS primary_source, argMax(properties.secondary_copy, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS secondary, argMax(properties.effective_backup_status, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS backup_status, argMax(properties.capability_widgets, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS widgets_available, argMax(properties.capability_purchase, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS purchase_available, argMax(properties.capability_onboarding, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS onboarding_available, argMax(properties.onboarding_state, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS onboarding_state, argMax(properties.widget_privacy, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS widget_privacy, argMax(properties.widget_privacy_source, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS widget_privacy_source FROM events WHERE event = 'configuration_snapshot' AND properties.release_channel = 'production' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND properties.platform = 'ios' AND properties.analytics_record_id IS NOT NULL AND toInt(properties.period_start_utc) >= toUnixTimestamp(now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY distinct_id) GROUP BY account_state, primary, primary_source, secondary, backup_status, widgets_available, purchase_available, onboarding_available, onboarding_state, widget_privacy, widget_privacy_source

insights.name: Storage, backup and widget publication reliability
insights.description: Deduplicated coverage-v2 daily fixed-code outcomes in the same consented sample. Storage writes, local backup/restore and widget snapshot publications have distinct denominators. Widget publication is not tracking or proof iOS displayed it. Crash diagnostics and server uptime are separate.
insights.query: SELECT sum(storage_success_count) AS storage_success, sum(storage_failure_count) AS storage_failed, storage_failed / nullIf(storage_success + storage_failed, 0) AS storage_failure_fraction, sum(backup_success_count) AS backup_success, sum(backup_failure_count) AS backup_failed, sum(widget_success_count) AS widget_publication_success, sum(widget_failure_count) AS widget_publication_failed FROM (SELECT distinct_id, properties.analytics_record_id AS record, any(toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS period, any(toInt(properties.storage_success_count)) AS storage_success_count, any(toInt(properties.storage_failure_count)) AS storage_failure_count, any(toInt(properties.backup_success_count)) AS backup_success_count, any(toInt(properties.backup_failure_count)) AS backup_failure_count, any(toInt(properties.widget_success_count)) AS widget_success_count, any(toInt(properties.widget_failure_count)) AS widget_failure_count FROM events WHERE event = 'feature_usage_daily' AND properties.release_channel = 'production' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND toInt(properties.coverage_version) >= 2 AND properties.platform = 'ios' AND properties.analytics_record_id IS NOT NULL AND toInt(properties.period_start_utc) >= toUnixTimestamp(now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY distinct_id, record)
insights.verification: Saved query executed successfully in whole-dashboard refresh; production empty

insights.name: Coverage / sampling / delivery-loss warnings
insights.description: Observed sample/version, partial consent days and incomplete coverage. delivery_loss_count is cumulative per installation; latest per installation prevents repeated loss overcounting. Queue/retention/cap losses mean missing data. No envelopes means unknown coverage.
insights.query: SELECT sample_rate, sampling_version, complete, partial, count() AS installations, sum(loss) AS latest_reported_loss FROM (SELECT distinct_id, argMax(properties.sample_rate, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS sample_rate, argMax(properties.sampling_version, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS sampling_version, argMax(properties.coverage_complete, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS complete, argMax(properties.collection_started_mid_period, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS partial, argMax(toInt(properties.delivery_loss_count), toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS loss FROM events WHERE event = 'feature_usage_daily' AND properties.release_channel = 'production' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND properties.platform = 'ios' AND properties.analytics_record_id IS NOT NULL AND toInt(properties.period_start_utc) >= toUnixTimestamp(now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY distinct_id) GROUP BY sample_rate, sampling_version, complete, partial
insights.verification: Saved query executed successfully in whole-dashboard refresh; production empty

insights.name: Monthly stored events — deduplicated budget signal
insights.description: Current-month stored rows and unique telemetry IDs across all channels in this project. Deduplicated storage is not authoritative ingress/billable usage. Published free allowance 1M/month; planning ceiling 700k. Owner confirms no billing; billing/spend cap is not API-verified.
insights.query: SELECT count() AS received_project_events, uniq(properties.analytics_record_id) AS distinct_contract_records, 700000 AS app_planning_ceiling, 1000000 AS published_free_allowance FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(now())
insights.verification: Saved query executed successfully in whole-dashboard refresh; production empty

insights.name: Onboarding — observed consented steps and endings
insights.query: SELECT properties.flow_mode AS flow_mode, event, if(event = 'onboarding_step_reached', properties.step, properties.outcome) AS stage, uniq(distinct_id) AS observed_installations, uniq(properties.analytics_record_id) AS records FROM events WHERE event IN ('onboarding_step_reached', 'onboarding_finished') AND properties.release_channel = 'production' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND properties.platform = 'ios' AND properties.analytics_record_id IS NOT NULL AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY flow_mode, event, stage ORDER BY flow_mode, event, stage
insights.description: First-run, replay and restore modes stay separate. Only destinations observed after opt-in count; pre-consent steps are never reconstructed. Unique installations per stage are descriptive, not an ordered conversion funnel. No account/person linkage.
insights.verification: Saved query executed successfully in whole-dashboard refresh; production empty

insights.name: First-run observed cohort — outcomes within seven days
insights.query: SELECT uniq(s.distinct_id) AS observed_first_run_installations, uniqIf(s.distinct_id, e.event = 'onboarding_finished' AND e.properties.flow_mode = 'first_run' AND e.properties.outcome = 'completed') AS completed_within_7_days, uniqIf(s.distinct_id, e.event = 'entity_created') AS created_within_7_days, uniqIf(s.distinct_id, e.event = 'activation_reached' AND e.properties.cohort = 'fresh_first_run') AS first_observed_tracking_within_7_days FROM (SELECT distinct_id, min(timestamp) AS started FROM events WHERE event = 'onboarding_step_reached' AND properties.flow_mode = 'first_run' AND properties.release_channel = 'production' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND properties.platform = 'ios' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY distinct_id) AS s LEFT JOIN events AS e ON e.distinct_id = s.distinct_id WHERE e.properties.release_channel = 'production' AND e.properties.schema_version = 1 AND e.properties.platform = 'ios' AND e.timestamp >= s.started AND e.timestamp <= s.started + INTERVAL 7 DAY
insights.description: Among opt-in iPhone installations with an observed first-run step: completed, new creation and first observed tracking within seven days of that step. Partial consent-biased funnel; stages are not required to occur in order. Replay and pre-consent history excluded.
insights.verification: Saved query executed successfully in whole-dashboard refresh; production empty

insights.query: SELECT distinct_id, max(timestamp) AS observed_at, argMax(properties.host, timestamp) AS placement, argMax(properties.kind_today_count, timestamp) AS today, argMax(properties.kind_item_count, timestamp) AS item, argMax(properties.kind_lock_today_count, timestamp) AS lock_today, argMax(properties.kind_icons_count, timestamp) AS icons, argMax(properties.kind_history_count, timestamp) AS history, argMax(properties.kind_tasks_count, timestamp) AS tasks, argMax(properties.family_small_count, timestamp) AS small, argMax(properties.family_medium_count, timestamp) AS medium, argMax(properties.family_large_count, timestamp) AS large, argMax(properties.family_accessory_inline_count, timestamp) AS accessory_inline, argMax(properties.family_accessory_circular_count, timestamp) AS accessory_circular, argMax(properties.family_accessory_rectangular_count, timestamp) AS accessory_rectangular FROM events WHERE event = 'widget_inventory' AND properties.query_result = 'success' AND properties.release_channel = 'production' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND properties.platform = 'ios' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY distinct_id ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 100
